name: Tabetha's Task
label: Quest
description: Tabetha's Task: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Rumor is that Tabetha, a mage colleague who lives deep in Dustwallow Marsh, has a bone to pick with a certain sand troll in Zul'Farrak. If you speak with Tabetha she can tell you more.
And bring some friends with you, friend. If Tabetha has you go to Zul'Farrak then you're not going to want to go alone.
You will find Tabetha's cottage west of Theramore, and just north of the Stonemaul Ruin.

clips.title: Completion
paras: That's right. I do have a bone to pick with a troll. A few bones. All her bones!
